declared_exclusions.reason: The coverage denominator is honestly 'absent' as a result. An object count (64 data files) is not a row count and inferring one would be a denominator about the wrong population. A pyiceberg scan is a heavier act than a qualify-only TO warranted against a store on no live read path.

declared_exclusions.reason: There is no live caller -- established, not assumed. That absence IS the measurement, and the row carries basis 'absent' with what was tried rather than a docstring-derived verdict.

declared_exclusions.item: Removing or corrupting a real spec file to observe the C2C3_MOTIF_SPEC_ABSENT WARN emission
declared_exclusions.reason: The spec files are live inputs to the nightly derive. The triggering condition and exception class were exercised instead; the emission itself is read at source and that limit is stated in the row.

declared_exclusions.item: End-to-end determinism comparison for comp_ladder and dup_scan
declared_exclusions.reason: comp_ladder's entrypoint exits rc=1 so two runs cannot be compared; dup_scan was not run over a full corpus. Both determinism claims are therefore basis INFERRED, not measured, rather than letting a source read carry a 'measured' label.

declared_exclusions.item: Counting the estate's distinct node types to size anchor_catalog's real coverage
declared_exclusions.reason: The denominator is deliberately worded as completeness OVER THE CATALOG, explicitly not coverage of the estate. The ratio that would matter -- anchor types over live estate types -- is unmeasured and said to be, rather than printing a flattering 8-of-8 that reads as full coverage.

declared_exclusions.item: A sweep of EventBridge and the Scheduler plane to prove resource_summaries has no trigger anywhere
declared_exclusions.reason: actual_trigger is basis INFERRED for exactly this reason. A one-plane or zero-plane absence claim is the trap this estate has measured twice, so 'no observed trigger' is not upgraded to 'no trigger'.

declared_exclusions.item: Systematic examination of the SEMANTIC axis on any subject
declared_exclusions.reason: Declared UNMEASURED in all six cards' verdict.why. The 31 enumerated opinions were forced into view by the key, coverage and failure_mode rows, not found by a deliberate sweep. Every instrument used -- AST parses, greps, rc checks, object listings, byte-compares -- is structurally blind to whether an opinion is still correct.

W2-m-3 and BOUNDARY-2: the tag is a SECOND PASS, after carding, and the sequencing is load-bearing because a lane expecting a subject to be discarded searches it less hard. forward_disposition is ABSENT from all 6 cards, verified programmatically. resource_summaries carries materializer_standing='superseded', which is a MEASURED statement about what the live path reads today and explicitly not a view on its fate.

declared_exclusions.item: A live account-wide comp-debris sweep to produce a coverage denominator
declared_exclusions.reason: Its population is scoped by --types (default lambda alone), --region (default one region) and --days, so any M would describe my flag choices rather than the tool. Reading live CloudWatch across an account is also heavier than a qualify-only TO warrants. denominator_absent_reason is populated with exactly this.
